content.content:
1. One commitment — what discard does to the draft's workspace. The dependent records one commitment: discarding forgets the draft's jj workspace and removes its directory under the per-user root, tolerating one already gone. Read its clauses and fail on any clause that can be decided, changed, or dropped on its own without the remaining clauses changing; name the clause and the separate commitment it settles. A clause also fails when its soundness rests on a decision that no prerequisite in depends_on records; name the clause and the missing decision. The store's removal of the record document — its path, the scan that discovers it, and the retention of every other record — is recorded elsewhere and is not an edge of this node; the discarded draft's change (whether or how it is abandoned or otherwise altered) is another commitment; and the verb surface (the command, its name, flags, arguments, output, refusal wording and exit status) is another. A clause that settles or re-settles any of them is a finding under this criterion — name the clause and the commitment it duplicates — not a licence failure under criterion 2, and the reviewer adds no rule or edge for it.

2. Licence, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite it names in depends_on. Read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite; fail on every contradicting element, naming the element and the prerequisite it departs from. The prerequisites recorded here decide, among them: a discard ends an open draft without landing, is not one of the three operations, opens no bracket and offers undo and redo no unit, and is not a repair of drift, while a drifted draft — an open record whose workspace is gone — is still an open draft and ending it is a discard like any other (tvxspkyy); a draft's jj workspace is created under one per-user draft-workspace root outside the repository, at a path inside that root that is the repository's own namespace together with the record's handle, and the record names the workspace by name and path as a reference rather than holding it (xqzstoyo); the workspace module creates, forgets and enumerates those workspaces, derives the directory as the per-user root, the repository's namespace and the handle with nothing appended, and forget checks membership against the enumeration first because jj exits zero with only a warning for a name it does not know, so an absent name is carried as Unknown with nothing removed rather than reported as a silent success (tyoypkmp); and jj owns whether a draft's workspace exists while the registry owns what the draft means, an open record whose workspace is gone is drift, a landed record whose workspace is gone is not, and reconcile reports the difference and never repairs, rewrites, drops or forgets the record, so a drifted open record stays open and still names the workspace (vuopwuyo).

3. Each clause's soundness rests on a named prerequisite. For each clause of the dependent, identify the prerequisite whose decision makes the clause sound; fail if that prerequisite is not named in depends_on, naming the clause and the missing decision. The identification is read off the clause's content, not off any citation the clause may carry. A clause whose soundness would need a decision no recorded prerequisite states — the store's removal of the record document, the discarded draft's change, or the verb surface — is a finding under criterion 1, not a licence gap under this criterion, because those decisions are not edges of this one.

The criterion reads the recorded dependent and its recorded prerequisites as they stand. It requires no file, module, flag or command, and no behavior probe; there is nothing to run. A reviewer applies it to the node documents and reports each failure by clause and by the prerequisite or commitment it departs from.
content.rationale:
The dependent is a commitment in words — its content is inline prose — and three of its four prerequisites carry prose (tvxspkyy, xqzstoyo, vuopwuyo), so those edges are natural-to-natural and take the base gate cell: a non-violation review of the dependent against the prerequisite, with no behavior probe. The fourth prerequisite, tyoypkmp, carries code (its ref is src/jj_workspace.rs), so its edge is code-parent to a natural child; the matrix leaves that cell at its default, which is the gate form plus a flag for a matrix entry. The evaluation therefore keeps the gate form for all four edges: a prose child is a commitment in words, and the strictness rule says an evaluation over it checks non-violation and never demands behavior, even though the prerequisite it leans on is executable. One evaluation covers all four edges because they answer one question — what discard does to a draft's workspace — and a single clause-by-clause pass reads the dependent against all four at once; splitting would read the same clauses four times.

Licence alone does not cover this use. A decision can avoid every contradiction and still be a bundle — a forget rule settled apart from a directory rule, the directory rule settled apart from the tolerance of an absence — so criterion 1 tests that the commitment is atomic and that its scope stops where other commitments begin: the store's removal of the record document, the discarded draft's change and the verb surface are recorded elsewhere and are not edges of this decision. Criterion 3 is the groundedness half of the same test: a clause that rests on a decision the dependent did not draw an edge to is unsound regardless of contradiction. Criterion 2 is the cell's licence check with the four prerequisites' content named so a reviewer can apply it at check time; it pins none of the dependent's wording and names no element of the dependent in advance. A clause with no prerequisite behind it, or one resting on the store removal, the change or the verb surface, is a finding under criterion 1 or 3 rather than a licence failure, because those are not rules any recorded prerequisite states.

The criterion is applied by reading the recorded nodes; no command runs. It reads a recorded commitment: until the dependent states what discard does to the workspace, there is no clause to read and no prerequisite can be named as its ground, so the criterion is not applicable before that commitment exists. The findings are the reviewer's output.
